description: VISION canonical proof-capability registry. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every Live verifier. All browser, Edge Function, PostgreSQL and QA allowlists are derived from or checked against this file by scripts/qa-proof-capabilities-parity.mjs. Never hand-edit an allowlist in one layer without updating this file — the parity CI fails on any drift.

verification_levels.$comment: Proof Contract v3 honesty taxonomy. `emitted` levels are the only ones the system actually claims today; `roadmap` levels are defined but NEVER emitted until a real qualified verifier ships. Mirrored by supabase/functions/_shared/proof-levels.mjs and pinned by scripts/qa-proof-levels.mjs. mode->level: reps=EXACT_REP, hold=EXACT_HOLD, duration=CONTINUOUS_ACTIVITY; voice=VOICE_SESSION; photo=PHOTO_FALLBACK.

VOICE_SESSION.claims: a spoken session against an audio rubric
never_claims: that a described real-world action happened

PHOTO_FALLBACK.claims: an uploaded photo as evidence of completion

FOCUS_SESSION.note: study/business tasks are PHOTO_FALLBACK today, not a claimed live focus session

CONNECTED_EVENT.note: connections-* infra exists but is dormant and not wired to proof award

capabilities.setup_instruction: Place your phone side-on so your shoulders, hips and ankles all stay in frame. Lower until your elbows bend near 90°.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the elbows do not bend to roughly 90 degrees, the hips sag or pike out of a straight line, only partial reps are shown, or the person leaves the frame.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Stand side-on to the phone with your hips, knees and ankles visible. Lower until your thighs reach at least parallel.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the squat does not reach at least parallel depth, the person stays standing, only partial reps are shown, or the hips and knees leave the frame.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Face the phone at a slight angle so both knees and hips stay visible. Lower until the front thigh reaches parallel.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the rear knee does not descend toward the floor, the front knee stays locked, only partial reps are shown, or the person leaves the frame.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Lie side-on to the phone so your shoulders, hips and knees stay in frame. Raise your torso toward your knees on each rep.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the torso does not rise toward the knees, the shoulders barely leave the floor, only partial reps are shown, or the body leaves the frame.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Set the phone facing you so the bar, your shoulders and your elbows are visible. Pull until your chin clears the bar.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the chin does not clear the bar, the arms do not fully extend at the bottom, only partial reps are shown, or the person leaves the frame.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Set the phone side-on so your shoulders, hips and ankles form one straight line in frame, then hold still.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the hips sag below or pike above a straight shoulder-hip-ankle line, the body drops out of plank position, the person leaves the frame, or the hold is not continuous.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Face the phone with your upper body and hands in frame, then keep moving and punching for the full duration.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the person stands still, the arms stop moving for extended periods, the body leaves the frame, or the video is a static timer.
capabilities.claim_note: VISION verified continuous movement for the required duration. It does not verify exact technique or a specific number of punches.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Set the phone facing you with your legs and feet in frame, then keep your feet moving for the full duration.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the feet stop moving, the person stands still, the legs leave the frame, or the video is a static timer.
capabilities.claim_note: VISION verified continuous footwork movement for the required duration. It does not verify exact ball touches or dribbling technique.

capabilities.setup_instruction: Set the phone facing you with your whole body in frame, then keep moving continuously for the full duration.
capabilities.default_reject_if: Reject if the person stands still, movement stops for extended periods, the body leaves the frame, or the video is a static timer.
capabilities.claim_note: VISION verified continuous physical movement for the required duration. It does not verify exact reps or specific technique.

capabilities.disabled_reason: No dedicated jumping-jack rep verifier has passed real-camera qualification. Rep-count tasks route to Photo; timed tasks route to generic_movement duration.
No dedicated burpee rep verifier has passed real-camera qualification. Rep-count tasks route to Photo; timed tasks route to generic_movement duration.
No dedicated mountain-climber rep verifier has passed real-camera qualification. Rep-count tasks route to Photo; timed tasks route to generic_movement duration.

qualification_policy: live_qualification records physical-camera benchmark status per capability. engineering_ready=true means the verifier + phase machine + anti-cheat exist and pass SYNTHETIC/fixture tests; real_camera_qualified=true requires a real-device benchmark run (owner) and is FALSE for every capability here. measured_precision/recall/false_accept_rate stay null until that run — never invent physical results. A capability may be production_enabled (engineering-ready pose Live) while real_camera_qualified=false; that Live cannot be rated 9+ until physically qualified. jumping_jack, burpee and mountain_climber keep exact counting disabled until qualified.

notes.production_enabled_verifiers: The union of production_enabled=true stored_verifier_id values MUST equal the PostgreSQL enforce_proof_contract / live_session allowlists and the QA production allowlist.
notes.known_verifiers: The union of ALL stored_verifier_id values MUST equal the browser and Edge Function verifier allowlists (a persisted contract may name any known verifier, but only production_enabled ones can open a camera or start a server session).
notes.disabled_families: jumping_jack, burpee and mountain_climber have no qualified dedicated rep verifier. The generator must express these as generic_movement duration (timed) or route rep-count claims to Photo; it must never persist an exact-rep contract for them.
